summary: Very steep kerb on a narrow hill street with flats 5 m away.
reasons: Narrow street, little room to pull in

best_section.where: Kings Road west kerb, uphill from the junction, beside the apartment block

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 5 m away on the same side and a house 10 m further up; more flats across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb on a narrow street with a few cars parked; no pull-off.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along the street, but none overnight evidence.

sun_shade: Open to the sky; the apartment block shades the morning side, with hedges and trees nearby.
